text: If it is your family's custom Remembering Sri Mahalakshmi Devi and Kubera Swamy, offer flowers and akshatalu in front of their pictures.
If you don't have their pictures, meditate on them in your mind and pray.
Bless our family with wealth and prosperity, financial stability and peace of mind.
Give us the wisdom to use the money we earn for good deeds.
Offer flowers and akshatalu and do namaskaram.
